subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar e comparar as várias editorias de jornais impressos e digitais e de sites noticiosos, de forma a refletir sobre os tipos de fato que são noticiados e comentados, as escolhas sobre o que noticiar e o que não noticiar e o destaque/enfoque dado e a fidedignidade da informação.

components.description_pt: Identificar diferentes seções editoriais de jornais impressos e digitais
components.description_en: Identify the different editorial sections of print and digital newspapers

components.description_pt: Comparar tipos de eventos reportados e comentados em diferentes veículos de notícia
components.description_en: Compare the types of events reported and commented on across news outlets
components.cc_component_description: Compare the most important points across two texts on the same topic

components.description_pt: Analisar escolhas editoriais sobre o que é coberto, omitido ou enfatizado
components.description_en: Analyze editorial choices regarding what is covered, omitted, or emphasized
components.cc_component_description: Compare the details emphasized across two different media accounts of the same subject

components.description_pt: Avaliar relevância e confiabilidade de evidências citadas com base em características da fonte
components.description_en: Assess the relevance and reliability of cited evidence based on its source features
components.cc_component_description: Assess the relevance and reliability of cited evidence based on its source features

cc_matches.description: Cite specific textual evidence to support analysis of primary and secondary sources, attending to such features as the date and origin of the information.
Compare and contrast the most important points presented by two texts on the same topic.
Analyze various accounts of a subject told in different mediums (e.g., a person's life story in both print and multimedia), determining which details are emphasized in each account.
